name: Awayuki Hiiro
source: A young girl who lives in the observatory. She is searching for beautiful things, such as the meaning of life, and keeps them recorded onto a map. She is a self-proclaimed genius. Despite her confidence in her own beauty, only very few people can actually stand spending time with her due to her eccentric behaviour and her curious nature. Sometimes she says "I'm off to meet with my neighbour" and just wanders off somewhere. Her favourite food is konpeito.
